Eulerroom’s Flok WeekEndJam is a weekly open collaborative live-coding session welcoming all levels; it is uploaded weekly and tagged with Strudel among other tools.
The (Algo|Afro) Futures showcase in the Strudel Showcase comes from a mentoring programme for early-career Black artists.

notes: Index/link only — no pattern code copied or summarised. Dates are YouTube upload dates from each watch page (uploadDate/publishDate); showcase titles/authors cross-checked with oEmbed. "from": showcase = listed in Showcase.jsx; channel-rss = present in the channel RSS (latest 15); search = found via the channel’s /videos, /shorts, /streams listing pages or YouTube search (the schema has no channel-page value). Every item's watch page was fetched. Strudel filter: title/description/tags mention Strudel; for Switch Angel/AngelVision/Maria Areadne, live-coding videos from mid-2023 that do not name the tool are kept with strudel_evidence "inferred" (she performs in Strudel) — drop them if strictness matters. Switch Angel music videos, album uploads and auto-generated "Switch Angel - Topic" audio were excluded. Genres are inferred from titles/descriptions unless noted; kind/level are heuristic from titles. Extra fields: duration, strudel_evidence, showcase_title_on_site/youtube_title. Channel resolution: typedbeats is @typedbeats-daily (@typedbeats 404s); Wave Coder is @WaveCodr (@WaveCoder/@wavecoder resolve to an empty "wavecode" channel); Iganu music is UCY7tXqRgSZS0eemuhMUT6LA (@IganuMusic resolves to an empty different channel); Creative Code Art is @Creativecodeartcommunity (@CreativeCodeArt resolves to "Algorist"). Eulerroom coverage is partial: the channel has thousands of uploads; Strudel sets were found via channel search "strudel", RSS and YouTube search, so older solstice/TOPLAP sets that only name Strudel deep in descriptions may be missing. Groovin in G: all ~240 listed uploads checked; only 4 mention Strudel. Creative Code Art: ~55 uploads checked; 4 Strudel (2 are the same CNDSD set, full + short). eddyflux channel was added as a source because 5 Showcase items live there (the Chalmers clip is included from the channel though the Showcase comments it out). YouTube rate-limited (429) briefly mid-run; all items were re-fetched successfully. Per-channel counts (excluding showcase rows): Eulerroom 81, Switch Angel 65, Wave Coder 45, typedbeats 41, Iganu music 30, AngelVision 23, Maria Areadne 9, Creative Code Art 4, Groovin in G 4, eddyflux 1
